newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: IHC Caland in Vietnam offshore deal.
newsitem.headline: IHC Caland in Vietnam offshore deal.

text.p: Shipbuilding and engineering group IHC Caland NV said on Thursday it had received a letter of intent from Japan Vietnam Petroleum Corporation to supply a floating production and storage system (FPSO).
"The letter of intent comprises the lease and operational management of the FPSO for a minimum period of three years, with possible one-year extensions," IHC Caland said in a statement.
Under the deal, IHC subsidiary SBM Production Contractors Inc will convert an existing tanker for delivery in 1998.
SBM will own 70 percent of the FPSO, with the remaining 30 percent being held by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries.
It will be used in developing the Rang Dong offshore oilfield in Vietnam.
IHC said this latest FPSO represented the eighth to be leased and operated by its SBM unit.
